intelligence.title: Elevated, Always — The Dual-Depth Standard
intelligence.essence: Shawn's design law 2026-10-21: everything in NayaNET is elevated, always - nothing flat. Inputs are wells carved INTO the screen; actions are buttons raised OUT toward the hand; displays are lit panels. Every element carries inset highlight, inset shadow, a light-carrying border, outer glow, and drop shadow. Depth has a direction and the direction means something. One flat element cheapens everything elevated around it. Naya is the inspector: she does not report-and-walk-on, she makes sure it is done.

connections.note: 'The input box should look like it is going into the screen. The ENTER should feel like it is coming out of the screen.'
